title: Reference data pack manifest
description: data-pack/manifest.json — GENERATED by data-pack/build/build-cli.ts, never hand-edited. Mirrors DataPackManifestSchema in packages/shared/src/data-pack.ts; a test holds the two in agreement.

packVersion.description: Semver core. Taken from data-pack/package.json `version`; a pack may never go backwards (D-DP5).

schemaVersion.description: Pack LAYOUT version. Changes when the shape of a pack changes, never when its values do.

asOf.description: The newest `as_of` across every source file in the pack. Derived, not wall-clock — the drift test rebuilds this and byte-compares.

generator.description: Repo-relative path of the generator that wrote this manifest.

files.description: Every shipped pack file EXCEPT manifest.json itself, sorted by path.

path.description: Pack-root-relative POSIX path. No leading slash, no `..`.

sha256.description: Lowercase hex SHA-256 of the file's bytes.
